## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (62%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
The 90% conformal set includes Normal, InSitu (22%), and Benign (8%), with 8% invasive risk [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 62%, InSitu 22%, Benign 8%, Invasive 8% | Normal leads; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Normal, Benign, InSitu (90% target coverage) | Cannot exclude InSitu or Benign |
| Reliability / OOD | 93% reliability, 88th OOD percentile (12/12 regions) [F6] | Passes QC; moderately atypical embeddings |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (83%–86% similarity) [F5] | All five nearest neighbors match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.69), but 0/20 AI spot check failed [F2] · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 7, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.59) opposes invasion; 20/20 AI spot check [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.36) opposes invasion; 19/20 AI spot check [F4] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 4, 5) · ↑ invasive · High score (+0.34) favors invasion, but 0/20 spot check failed · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score (+0.22 contribution); 12/20 AI spot check · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); leans on Unreliable normal_lobules, mitoses, and necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- High-risk regions 5 (78% risk) and 1 (59% risk) harbor focal in situ (22% probability) or invasive carcinoma.
- Simulated frozen-section limits hide atypia needing drafted deeper levels, or superior (100%) and medial (86%) margins are involved [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 1**: Highest risk scores (78%, 59%); rule out focal stromal invasion or in situ carcinoma.
2. **Regions 9, 4**: Check ductal atypia and lymphocytes/pleomorphism (contrast InSitu case BACH_0117, 82% similarity) for drafted deeper levels.
3. **Regions 0, 3, 7, 8, 11**: Confirm benign lobules/stroma and verify clear superior and medial margins.
